ledger.sourceFiling: Form F-3/A, Registration No. 333-297222; effective August 11, 2026
ledger.terms: The prospectus permits the company, from time to time and in one or more offerings, to offer up to $100 million aggregate of Class A ordinary shares, debt securities, and warrants; securities may also be convertible or exchangeable. This is dollar capacity, not a disclosed share count or evidence that securities were sold. [48719,48720]
ledger.eligibilityAssessment: The EFFECT makes the F-3 registration effective, meaning securities may be offered under the registration statement. The bundle does not show a takedown, pricing, issuance, or sales under the shelf. [48719,48720]
